key_concepts: The menstrual cycle prepares the female body for pregnancy
The average menstrual cycle lasts about 28 days
Menstruation is the monthly shedding of the endometrium
A female's first menstrual flow is called menarche
Menarche signals that the body is ready for reproduction
Menstrual blood flows from the uterus through the cervix and out the vagina
Menstrual periods usually last from 3 to 5 days
The menstrual cycle has four phases: menstrual, follicular, ovulation, and luteal
The menstrual phase occurs around days 1-7
During the follicular phase, estrogen causes the uterine lining to thicken
Ovulation is the release of a mature egg from the ovary into the fallopian tube
Fertilization may take place during the ovulation phase
